body.x: Lifefuels showed ‘Smart Nutrition Bottle’ for the personalized beverage manufacture at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

Founded in 2014, Lifefuels received the CES Innovation Award for Sports, Fitness, and Biology, its second annual award for innovation, followed by that in 2016. The prize is made up of a liquid form including three essential vitamins and nutrients that each of them have named as ‘Natural Energy’ without BPA, ‘Hydrate Plus’, and ‘Daily Essentials’.

Lifefuels developed a smart nutrition bottle to make it easy for consumers to get the number of nutrients they want for the day. Three nutrient drinks can be put into bottles to help consumers mix the number of nutrients they want. This product has great potential because of its different nutritional and digestive needs.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
